1.consolidated_definition: "Acobardarse": ser un sustantivo que se refiere a una persona que experimenta un intenso miedo o temor que impide actuar con valentía o decisión.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To cower: a noun referring to an individual who experiences intense fear or apprehension that prevents them from acting with courage or decisiveness.
